description: Result `range` values are `[start_row, start_col, end_row, end_col]`: rows are 1-based, columns are 0-based UTF-8 BYTE offsets (tree-sitter convention, not character indexes), and the end is exclusive.

include_imports.description: Include import/use rows. Off by default — they bloat the outline and rarely aid orientation.

include_bodies_for.description: Names whose full body to inline into the outline. Orient AND fetch selected bodies in one call — saves a round-trip vs an outline followed by separate get_symbol calls. Bodies appear on matching nodes' `body` field.

max_body_lines.description: Keep this many source lines per inlined body (from `include_bodies_for`), eliding the middle with an additional `… N lines elided …` marker line that reports the true line count. The serialized body may therefore contain up to `max_body_lines + 1` lines. Omit to use `default_body_line_limit`; explicit values are clamped to `max_body_line_limit`.

limit.description: Cap on the number of top-level outline symbols returned before truncation. Defaults to the server `default_result_limit`, clamped to `max_result_limit`. Pagination operates on the outer symbol list only.

offset.description: Stable pagination offset over the top-level symbol list. Use `next_offset` from the response to resume.
